# The one normalization list (spec §9), shared by the golden recorder
# (tests/compat/record.rs) and the compat suite. Rules apply top to bottom
# to every recorded output; tests/compat/normalize.rs implements them.
#
# <rule>  <argument>  <placeholder>
#
#   sub    <var>     replace each occurrence of the run's value for <var>
#   word   <var>     same, but only where it stands as a whole word
#   tty    <prefix>  <prefix> followed by digits (a tty name)
#   ctime  -         an asctime-style date: "Mon Sep 28 10:00:00 2026"
#   epoch  -         a 10-digit number within the run's time window
#   pid    -         a whole number within the run's pid window, or one of
#                    the run's exact pids
#
# The epoch and pid windows can mask bugs: a wrong pid or a wrong time that
# falls inside the window still normalizes to the placeholder. A suite that
# knows its pids (grofe's own server and panes) should pass them exactly and
# drop the window. The recorder uses a window because it cannot know every
# pid tmux forks.
#
# Vars the runner supplies: socket (the private -L socket's path), tmpdir
# (the run's tempdir, holding TMUX_TMPDIR and HOME), host, user. The
# recorder runs as the user `golden`, so the user rule never meets tmux's
# `root` key table. A var the runner leaves unset or empty skips its rule. Longer values go first, so
# the socket path is replaced before the tempdir it sits in.

sub    socket     <SOCKET>
sub    tmpdir     <TMPDIR>
word   host       <HOST>
word   user       <USER>
tty    /dev/pts/  <TTY>
tty    /dev/ttys  <TTY>
ctime  -          <TIME>
epoch  -          <EPOCH>
pid    -          <PID>
